[[Category:Token]]
'''Tokenisation''' is the process of segmenting raw data into tokens.<ref>{{#cite:Q3108}}</ref>

== Definition ==

Formally, let $\mathcal{S}$ be a sequence of data. Any function

$$
\tau: \mathcal{S} \to \mathcal{V}^{*}
$$

is a '''tokenisation function''', sometimes called a '''tokeniser'''.

where $|\mathcal{V}| \ll \infty$ is known as the '''token vocabulary'''.
